_doc: The canonical aDNA property list — every legitimate domain, repository, organization and machine surface, plus retired ones. HAUSSMANN P1.2, the instrument's 7.1 clone-site defense. Data lives here (not in the TypeScript wrapper) so that BOTH the rendering page and the gate can read the same single source: a Playwright spec cannot import the .ts wrapper, because that transitively imports install_truth.json and Node rejects a JSON import without an import attribute. Keeping the data in JSON lets gate-15's G6b assertions read it with readFileSync and check true set equality against what the page renders.
_probe_discipline: Every row's `resolves` + `probed` records a real HTTP check, run from outside and logged out, on the date shown. `probed` is a statement about a past check, never a claim about the present — which is why it cannot rot into a falsehood, only into obvious staleness. To add a row: probe it logged out, record the result and the date, then list it. Never the reverse.
_not_listed: A property that 404s or is private does NOT belong here even if we own it — this page lists what a reader can trust AND reach. aDNA-Network/Videos.aDNA is the live instance: under the canonical org, but 404 publicly. It is disclosed as a count on /state-of-the-network, never as a link, so R-90's defect (shipping an outbound proof-link a reader cannot follow) is not re-created.
_consistency: The canonical-repo and legacy-repo URLs below are ALSO derived in canonical_properties.ts from install_truth.json and asserted equal at build time — so writing them literally here cannot silently drift from the generated install truth. A mismatch throws during `astro build`.

properties.label: adna.network
properties.what: The canonical site — this one. Everything official starts here.

properties.label: community.adna.network
properties.what: The community space: self-hosted, human-to-human, and early. Its honest current state is described on the community page.

properties.label: worldgeno.me
properties.what: The World Genome Academy's public site. Pre-launch at the last check.
properties.ownerNote: A subnetwork's own public site. Its vault is one of the vaults counted above, on the same computer — this is not a second, independent operator.

properties.label: github.com/aDNA-Network
properties.what: The only GitHub organization aDNA publishes under. Code claiming to be aDNA from any other organization is not ours.

properties.label: aDNA-Network/aDNA
properties.what: The clone-and-run workspace, MIT-licensed. This is what the install instructions point at.

properties.label: aDNA-Network/aDNA.aDNA
properties.what: The workspace this website is built from — the standard, applied to itself, in public.

properties.label: aDNA-Network/adna-legacy
properties.what: Frozen history from before the current repository layout. Archived and read-only — kept for the record, not for use.

properties.label: Wilhelm-Foundation/rare-archive
properties.what: The Rare Archive, in the Wilhelm Foundation’s own GitHub organization under Apache-2.0. Legitimately connected to aDNA, and not controlled by it.
properties.ownerNote: In the Wilhelm Foundation's own GitHub organization, under their control, not ours.

properties.label: /llms.txt
properties.what: The curated index this site offers to AI agents.

properties.label: /rss.xml
properties.what: The release feed for this site. One entry so far.

properties.label: /sitemap-index.xml
properties.what: Every page on this site, listed for search engines.

properties.label: adna.dev
properties.what: An early domain for this project, abandoned before launch. It does not resolve. If it ever resolves again, it is not us then either.

_owner_note: `sameAsExcluded` means ONLY: this URL is not an identity of the aDNA Network organization, so it must not appear in Organization.sameAs. It does NOT mean an independent party operates it — worldgeno.me is a subnetwork's site whose vault runs on the same single computer as the rest. Display uses `ownerNote`, which says what is actually true per property. Conflating the two produced a 'not ours' badge that implied independence the network has not earned — the exact borrowed-trust move this campaign exists to delete.
